summary: Itau Unibanco Holding S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing the filing of its 2025 Annual Report on Form 20-F with the SEC and the CVM on April 29, 2026. The filing is a routine annual disclosure of audited financial statements and does not involve any corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The registrant's role is as the issuer of the report. No deal terms or special-situation structural details are present. This is a standard periodic filing, with no risk-arb angle or catalyst to monitor.
